target: thermal decomposition onset temperature in degrees Celsius
training_scope: 36 monovalent CHNO cations paired with the pentazolate anion

features.rdkit_descriptors: all descriptors exposed by the installed RDKit version, sorted by name

limitations: LOO R2 is only 0.19; predictions are screening estimates, not quantitative guarantees
The conformal interval is an in-domain empirical interval and is not guaranteed out of domain
Thermal decomposition depends on experimental protocol and solid-state effects not encoded by 2D cation features
